summary: This bill amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to gradually increase the federal minimum wage to $26.59 per hour by January 1, 2030, and then adjust it every seven years thereafter to be 40 percent higher than the federal supplemental poverty threshold for a renter family of four with two children, as determined by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Fair Labor Standards Act to significantly increase the federal minimum wage over several years and then tie it to a living wage formula. This is a core labor policy that directly impacts workers' wages and working conditions, aligning with the 'more labor laws' aspect of the topic.
